desc: Ideation: model as functional graph on 26 letters; per-position consistency; chains cost 1 per changing letter; cycles cost k+1 with external buffer, k-1 if a member absent from S, impossible if all 26 letters present.
Implement: parse N, S, T; build f[26] (target or -1); conflict → -1.
DFS/iterative walk on functional graph to classify each letter: fixed point, chain, or cycle member; record final image or cycle id.
Validate all positions: final image of S[i] must equal T[i] (cycle letters: T[i] must be in same cycle), else -1.
Count base ops (letters in S with f[c]≠c); per cycle: if a member absent from S → +0; else if any non-cycle letter absent from S → +1; else → -1.
Verify logic mentally against all four samples (4, 0, -1, 4), then output final code reading stdin and writing stdout.

Edge-case audit: found over-strict chain validation (chains always feasible via sink-first renaming) and self-loop misclassification; simplified model: answer = changing letters + non-trivial cycles, -1 iff cycle exists with all 26 letters in S.
Rewrite final code per verified simplified model: conflict check, cycle detection on letters in S, answer = #{c in S: f(c)≠c} + #cycles, -1 if cycle and all 26 letters appear in S.
